description: Animation tables of the story characters in the cutscenes of map7_s02 (Nowhere - Alessa vs. Dahlia cutscene). A cutscene asks whether a character's animation is done ("playback") and which keyframe it starts at ("start_keyframe"; the same tables as playback when absent); the answer comes from the table named here, a file gamedata/tables/anim/<table>.json indexed by the character's animation status. "tables" maps a character name to its table and "fallback" is the table of every character not listed (none: such a character has no table). On this map, playback: Dahlia uses "dahlia", GhostChildAlessa uses "ghost_child_alessa", Kaufmann uses "kaufmann", GhostDoctor uses "ghost_doctor" and other characters have no table. Start keyframe: Dahlia uses "dahlia", GhostChildAlessa uses "ghost_child_alessa", Kaufmann uses "kaufmann", Lisa uses "lisa", BloodyLisa uses "bloody_lisa" and other characters have no table. The first-keyframe query knows Lisa and Bloody Lisa but not the Ghost Doctor, as in the original. Sounds that an animation keyframe cues play at volume 128 (no "cue_sounds" here). Read when the map loads.
